label: Tanec · Flamenco
desc: Dupání podpatků, kroužení zápěstí, tlesknutí, otočka se sukní, hrdý postoj.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: she stomps her heels on the wooden floor three times, arching her back with each stomp, and ends with her chin raised
she slowly raises both arms overhead over the whole shot, wrists twisting in circular flamenco wrist-work, and ends with arms high
she claps her hands sharply above her head once and snaps her face toward the camera with an intense gaze, then holds
she spins once, her skirt flaring out in a wide arc around her legs, and ends facing the camera as the skirt settles
she strikes a proud final stance, one hand on her hip and head tilted back, and holds it perfectly still
